title: Ketamine for Depression: A Complete Guide
description: Everything you need to know about ketamine and Spravato (esketamine) for depression. How it works, costs, what to expect, and whether it's right for you.

content.text: Ketamine has emerged as one of the most significant advances in depression treatment in decades. Unlike traditional antidepressants that take weeks to work, ketamine can produce relief within hours. Here's what you need to know.

Ketamine works through a completely different mechanism than SSRIs. It blocks NMDA glutamate receptors, which triggers a cascade of effects including increased BDNF (brain-derived neurotrophic factor) and rapid synapse formation.
Research shows ketamine increases synaptic connections in the prefrontal cortex within 24 hours—essentially helping the brain 'rewire' itself.

content.text: Meta-analyses show approximately 50-70% of treatment-resistant depression patients respond to ketamine, with effects often appearing within 24-72 hours.
The rapid onset is ketamine's major advantage. Traditional antidepressants typically take 4-6 weeks to work.

items: Need rapid relief (severe symptoms, suicidal thoughts)
Willing to commit to multiple sessions
No history of psychosis or substance abuse
IV ketamine: $400-800 per infusion, 6+ needed initially
Spravato: Often covered by insurance with prior authorization

content.text: Ketamine offers genuine hope for treatment-resistant depression, with faster onset than any other option. It's not a cure—most people need ongoing maintenance—but for those who haven't responded to other treatments, it can be life-changing.
